summary: Iteration 4 - Proof-of-Work system (immutable revenue ledger + publishing log + $25K profit meter). Backend: 35/35 pytest tests PASS including all new ledger & publishing endpoints and live monthly_actual computation. Frontend: all target UI features verified end-to-end on https://gmaos-control.preview.emergentagent.com - ProfitMeter on Command Center, Proof of Work nav under Revenue, /proof-of-work page with empty states + CTAs, Record Earnings + Log Post dialogs both POST successfully (201) and react-query invalidation updates the meter, ledger table, publishing table, and Revenue stream cards live without page reload. /revenue page shows live per-stream monthly_actual ($220 entry on rev-001 reflected immediately on Revenue Automation overview Total Actual=$220 and on AI Blog Network card actual=$220, 6% progress).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' - accessibility hint only, non-blocking. Adding <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby attribute would silence it.

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to RecordEarningsDialog and LogPostDialog to silence accessibility warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Ledger router enforces immutability correctly (no PATCH/DELETE endpoints) - matches the 'proof-of-work' contract.

revenue.list_revenue_streams and revenue.get_revenue_stats now compute monthly_actual LIVE by aggregating revenue_ledger entries with occurred_on >= month_start - confirmed working; seeded monthly_actual=0 is correctly overlaid.
PublishingRecord PATCH route back-fills posted_at when status moves directly to verified - good UX; verified explicitly tested.
Pydantic Field(ge=0) on gross/net produces 422 as expected; business rule net<=gross returns 400 - clean separation.
Audit log emits ledger.entry.recorded and publishing.<status> events - verified via /api/audit/.
Frontend react-query invalidates ['ledger','ledgerProgress','revenueStreams','revenueStats'] on ledger create - meter and revenue cards update without manual refresh (verified visually).

All new components and pages expose data-testid attributes consistently (profit-meter-full/-compact, ledger-row-*, publishing-row-*, record-earnings-*, log-post-*, nav-proof-of-work) - testable surface is solid.
Minor: routes/ledger.py uses module-level `import datetime as _dt` inside test file is fine but the actual route imports are clean. No file is >700 lines. No DRY violations spotted.
